automationNotes: Initial snapshot used unsupported pm check-permission; recovered with dumpsys metadata. External content CLI could not access private provider even under run-as on this emulator; no app permission changed. Diagnostics will be read in the visible QA UI.
First upgrade-check selected Chat before the cold React navigation had settled; the ignored driver was changed to wait for visible tabs. The actual upgrade persistence assertion then passed.
After the owner resumed hours later, the emulator was closed. Reopened the same Medium_Phone AVD without wipe; initial instrumentation attempt before reopening was NOT RUN.
The ignored artifact helper initially referred to a renamed corpus path; corrected to the unchanged Phase07 corpus before recording manifests. No application source change.

Two initial large-font/narrow-screen attempts could not locate month controls. Inspection showed the test helper swiped at fixed y1650, inside the wrapped bottom navigation on a2000px-high screen. Changed only ignored test-helper swipe coordinates to use actual display dimensions and scroll above navigation. Both initial attempts restored original display/theme in cleanup; application source unchanged.

Initial manual speech-copy test reached the real change review but tried to tap Discard before scrolling its button into view. Corrected only the ignored UI helper; review was never confirmed. Final rebuilt installation invalidated that transient review.
